metadata.description: Candidate-only local SEC scheduled-run plan. This file describes reviewed local preview cadence and safe command sequencing, but it is not loaded by the app and does not execute jobs.
source_policy_notes: Schedules are local planning records only.
No browser, backend, hosted worker, or automatic job runner reads this file.
Network calls require a human to run a printed command with --allow-network and --user-agent.
Review-only candidate writes require a human to run a printed command with --write-candidates.
Production promotion remains manual and must not be triggered by this schedule.

schedules.description: Weekly local preview plan for the approved mega-cap SEC job.
